note: HCM changes Oracle announces as Redwood default switches, end of support, migrations or removals. Not part of Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list and not counted as former opt-ins.

items.title: Redwood Extended Lookup Codes page by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: The Extended Lookup Codes page switches to Redwood by default from 26B; Oracle no longer fixes or enhances the classic page.

items.title: Redwood Document Type Security Profiles page by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: The Document Type Security Profiles page switches to Redwood by default from 26B; Oracle no longer fixes or enhances the classic page.

items.title: Redwood UK Payroll pages by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: Four UK Payroll pages switch to Redwood by default in 26B.

items.title: Redwood Oracle Communicate by default
items.revert: None stated: Oracle deprecates the profile option
items.summary: Oracle Communicate switches to Redwood by default from 26B, and its Redwood profile option is deprecated.

items.title: Legacy Dynamic Skills no longer supported
pages: Skill sections subscribed to Skills Center
items.oracle_title: IMPORTANT: Mandatory Migration to Enhanced Dynamic Skills
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: Skill sections that subscribe to Skills Center must move to Enhanced Dynamic Skills; Oracle stops supporting legacy Dynamic Skills from 26B.

items.title: Predictive-AI skill suggestions no longer supported
pages: Skill suggestions in Skills Center, job and position profiles, role guides, requisitions, gigs and learning items
items.oracle_title: IMPORTANT: Mandatory Migration to Enhanced Skills Suggestions Using Generative AI
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: Skill suggestions based on predictive AI are no longer supported from 26B; Oracle replaces them with generative-AI suggestions.

items.title: Redwood workforce structures pages by default (first set)
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: Five workforce structures pages switch to Redwood by default from 26C.

items.title: Redwood Benefits pages by default
items.revert: None stated on this page
items.summary: Benefits self-service and administration pages default to Redwood from 26C; Oracle delivers new Benefits enhancements in Redwood only.

items.title: Redwood UK self-service payroll pages by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: The UK Pension Enrollment and New Starter Declaration self-service pages switch to Redwood by default from 26C.

items.title: Suggested Career feature no longer supported
items.oracle_title: Mandatory migration to enhanced career role suggestions using generative AI
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: Oracle stops supporting the predictive-AI Suggested Career feature from 26C and replaces it with generative-AI career role suggestions.

items.title: Hybrid skill-suggestion logic retired
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: Oracle retires the Hybrid skill-suggestion logic after 26B; requisitions not on the Redwood creation flow and details page no longer show suggested skills.

items.title: Redwood person pages by default (moved from 26C)
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: Six person pages switch to Redwood by default in 26D; Oracle had planned this for 26C.

items.title: Redwood employment pages by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: 21 employment pages, from Hire an Employee to Promote and Transfer, switch to Redwood by default in 26D.

items.title: Redwood workforce structures pages by default (second set)
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: Jobs, Locations, Departments, Enterprise HCM Information and Grade Ladders switch to Redwood by default in 26D.

items.title: Redwood My Compensation and Compensation Info by default
items.revert: Site-level profile option ORA_CMP_SPOTLIGHT_REDWOOD_ENABLED can be set to No
items.summary: My Compensation and Compensation Info open in Redwood by default from 26D.

items.title: Responsive Career Development pages no longer supported
items.oracle_title: Mandatory migration to Redwood Career Development
items.revert: None stated: automatic move to Redwood in 27A
items.summary: Responsive Career Development pages are no longer supported after 26D; anyone still on them moves to Redwood automatically in 27A.

items.title: Old recommendations framework stops
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: If the new Recommendations framework (available since 25A) is not enabled before 26D, recommendations no longer appear in Oracle Learning.

items.title: Process Automation task type removed from journey setup
pages: Journey templates, task groups and task library
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: From 26D you can no longer create journey tasks with the Process Automation task type; Oracle Process Automation reaches end of life on 31 October 2026.

items.title: Create Time Card Calculation Component process disabled
pages: Time elements upgraded with Create Time Card Calculation Component
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: From 26D the Create Time Card Calculation Component process is disabled; Oracle asks you to reimplement upgraded time elements by 27D.

items.title: Digital Assistant on recruiting sites phased out
pages: Recruiting career sites using Digital Assistant
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: From November 2026 Oracle no longer supports Digital Assistant Fusion Apps templates; only sites that already use it keep it for now.

items.title: Redwood Resign, Terminate and Mass Assignment Change by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: Resign, Terminate and Mass Assignment Change switch to Redwood by default in 27A (the Redwood Mass Assignment Change page arrives in 26D).

items.title: Redwood Positions pages and guided processes by default
items.revert: Profile option can be set back to No
items.summary: Positions pages and the Request a New Position and Request a Position Change guided processes switch to Redwood by default in 27A.

items.title: Only Redwood calculation cards supported (Canada)
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: From 27A Oracle supports only the Redwood versions of these Canadian calculation cards.

items.title: Only Redwood Employee Tax Card supported (Mexico)
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: From 27A Oracle supports only the Redwood version of the Mexican Employee Tax Card.

items.title: Apply with Indeed discontinued
pages: Apply with Indeed on Oracle career sites
items.revert: None stated: Oracle points to Direct Apply with Indeed (since 25D)
items.summary: Apply with Indeed is phased out from 27A; Oracle points to Direct Apply with Indeed, available since 25D.

items.title: Learning BI Cloud Connector extracts replaced
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: Learning BICC is no longer supported from 27A; Oracle replaces it with Learning Catalog and Assignments Data Extraction (26C).

items.title: Calendar event template switched on
items.revert: None stated
items.summary: If you have not enabled Configure Calendar Event Body (available since 25D) before 27C, that update switches it on.
